answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: full rewards require partners spanning 12 unrelated wallets per epoch; trading inside a narrow mirror clique of look-alikes caps payouts at 10%. Each fake needs its own counterparties, so forging 100 identities means funding 1,200 relationships at 5 credits each — 6,000 credits against about 800 in rewards. Honest work spirals outward to new partners, while sable-dark rings pay it a hundred times over.
